items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Now, there is a guy from South Africa, his name is Kevin Curran. You ever heard of him?

ctx.x: Is there any similarity between Jazz and Tennis?

Uh, there must be! I never thought of this. I know that there is an awful lot of rhythm connected with tennis. I can tell by watching the guy's serve whether he has the ability to be a good tennis player or not.

Now, there is a guy from South Africa, his name is Kevin Curran. You ever heard of him? He's got a real fast-draw serve. He's like Roscoe Tanner, in a way. And you know, when Roscoe Tanner lost his serve... His serve disappeared, you know, he started hitting that net instead of putting them over and making forty aces in a row, like he used to. His rating went [PLUMMETING SOUND]. You don't hear anybody talk about Roscoe Tanner any more. He used to serve the ball 145 miles an hour. That's fast. That'll take your…
